Get to Know
## Meet Caden
Caden Cotton-Blake is a lifelong resident of San Pablo dedicated to building a stronger and more equitable future for the city he calls home. Through his work in public service, economic advocacy, youth engagement, and community organizing, he has focused on ensuring that residents have access to opportunity, affordable housing, and a meaningful voice in local government.
Read My Full Story
Lifelong San Pablo Resident
Community Engagement Manager
Youth and Civic Organizer
Endorsed by Community Leaders
A Vision for San Pablo
## Why I'm Running
San Pablo is a city with so much to love and protect, and even more we can achieve together. We will invest in our families, strengthen our neighborhoods, and create new opportunities for the next generation.
### Invest in Families
Supporting the people who make San Pablo home
### Strengthen Neighborhoods
Building safer, more connected communities
### Create Opportunity
Opening doors for the next generation
There is nothing we cannot accomplish as one community, and your support will help pave the way for the next chapter of San Pablo's story.
